title: Support theorem of universal compactified Jacobians
summary: We prove a full support theorem for the relative good moduli space of the universal compactified Jacobian $\barπ\colon \overline{J}_{g,n}^{d,φ}\to \overline{\mathcal{M}}_{g,n}$, showing that every direct summand appearing in the BBDG decomposition of $\mathrm{R}\barπ_*\mathrm{IC}(\overline{J}_{g,n}^{d,φ})$ has full support on the base $\overline{\mathcal{M}}_{g,n}$. Moreover, we explicitly describe this decomposition governed by the derived pushforward of the constant sheaf on the universal curve.
